title: ASML 微影投影光學工程
summary: 以 ASML TWINSCAN 的 4 倍縮小投影鏡頭為對象，從 CD = k₁·λ/NA 與景深出發，拆解熔融石英與 CaF₂ 鏡片的面形預算、NA 1.35 折反射浸潤架構與偏振、原位波前量測與 Zernike 分解、鏡片熱漂移與操縱器校正，最後整合成套刻預算與成像驗收記錄。
summaryEn: Taking the 4× reduction projection lens of an ASML TWINSCAN as the object, this course starts from CD = k₁·λ/NA and depth of focus, then works through figure budgets for fused-silica and CaF₂ elements, the NA 1.35 catadioptric immersion layout and polarization, in-situ wavefront metrology with Zernike decomposition, lens-heating drift and manipulator correction, and ends with the overlay budget and imaging acceptance record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 製程窗口練習：ArF 浸潤式 λ = 193 nm、NA = 1.35、水折射率 n = 1.437。邊緣光角度 sinθ = 1.35/1.437 = 0.939，θ = 70°。高 NA 景深用 DOF = λ/[2n(1 − cosθ)] 估算：cos70° = 0.342，DOF = 193/(2×1.437×0.658) = 193/1.891 ≈ 102 nm，與近軸 λ/NA² ≈ 106 nm 相近。對焦預算以均方根合成：晶圓形貌 25 nm、晶圓台對焦 15 nm、鏡頭場曲 10 nm、調平感測 10 nm，RSS = √(625+225+100+100) = √1050 ≈ 32 nm；取正負兩側共 2×32 = 64 nm，留給光阻製程的可用景深約 102 − 64 = 38 nm。若 CD 以 k₁ = 0.28 計為 40 nm，CD 容差 ±10% 即 ±4 nm，Bossung 曲線必須在這 38 nm 內維持此容差。數值皆為教學假設，不代表任何機台規格。
workedExample.textEn: Process-window exercise: ArF immersion with λ = 193 nm, NA = 1.35 and water index n = 1.437. The marginal-ray angle is sinθ = 1.35/1.437 = 0.939, θ = 70°. Estimate the high-NA depth of focus with DOF = λ/[2n(1 − cosθ)]: cos70° = 0.342, so DOF = 193/(2×1.437×0.658) = 193/1.891 ≈ 102 nm, close to the paraxial λ/NA² ≈ 106 nm. Build the focus budget in quadrature: wafer topography 25 nm, stage focus 15 nm, lens field curvature 10 nm and levelling sensor 10 nm give RSS = √(625+225+100+100) = √1050 ≈ 32 nm; counting both sides, 2×32 = 64 nm, leaving about 102 − 64 = 38 nm of usable depth of focus for the resist process. With CD = 40 nm at k₁ = 0.28, the ±10% CD tolerance is ±4 nm, and the Bossung curves must hold that tolerance across those 38 nm. All values are teaching assumptions, not any tool's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「Rayleigh 解析度與景深的系統邊界」與「照明設定、部分同調與遠心」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: Rayleigh 解析度與景深的系統邊界：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Rayleigh resolution and depth-of-focus system boundaries: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「投影鏡頭數值孔徑與像方空間」如何決定ASML 微影投影光學工程的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Projection-lens NA and image space” determines the key performance of “ASML lithography projection-optics engineering”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 投影光學把光罩圖形縮小 4 倍成像到晶圓，能印出的最小特徵由 Rayleigh 關係 CD = k₁·λ/NA 決定：λ 是曝光波長，NA 是像方數值孔徑，k₁ 是由照明、光罩與光阻製程共同決定的製程因子，物理下限為 0.25。景深則隨 NA 平方縮小，DOF ≈ k₂·λ/NA²，所以提高 NA 換來解析度的同時，晶圓平坦度、對焦控制與鏡頭場曲的預算都被壓縮。ArF 浸潤式以水的折射率 1.437 把 NA 推到 1.35，EUV 則以 13.5 nm 波長在 NA 0.33 與 0.55 上取得更小的 CD。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「投影鏡頭數值孔徑與像方空間」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The projection optics image the reticle pattern onto the wafer at 4× reduction, and the smallest printable feature follows the Rayleigh relation CD = k₁·λ/NA, where λ is the exposure wavelength, NA the image-side numerical aperture and k₁ a process factor set jointly by illumination, mask and resist with a physical floor of 0.25. Depth of focus shrinks with the square of NA, DOF ≈ k₂·λ/NA², so every gain in resolution from NA compresses the budget left for wafer flatness, focus control and lens field curvature. ArF immersion uses water with index 1.437 to reach NA 1.35, while EUV reaches smaller CD at 13.5 nm with NA 0.33 and 0.55. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Projection-lens NA and image space”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With λ = 193 nm, NA = 1.35 and k₁ = 0.28, CD = 0.28×193/1.35 ≈ 40 nm; the smallest resolvable half-pitch is λ/(4NA) = 193/5.4 ≈ 36 nm (k₁ = 0.25).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要 k₁ 設得夠小，單次曝光就能印出任何間距。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With a small enough k₁, a single exposure can print any pitch." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「投影鏡頭數值孔徑與像方空間」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Projection-lens NA and image space”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: Rayleigh 解析度與景深的系統邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rayleigh resolution and depth-of-focus system boundaries: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「投影鏡頭數值孔徑與像方空間」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Projection-lens NA and image space” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：取 λ = 193 nm、NA = 1.35、k₁ = 0.28：CD = 0.28×193/1.35 ≈ 40 nm；最小可解析半週期為 λ/(4NA) = 193/5.4 ≈ 36 nm（k₁ = 0.25）。EUV 取 λ = 13.5 nm、NA = 0.33、k₁ = 0.4：CD ≈ 16 nm；NA = 0.55 時約 10 nm。近軸景深 λ/NA² 在浸潤式為 193/1.8225 ≈ 106 nm，在 EUV NA 0.33 為 124 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With λ = 193 nm, NA = 1.35 and k₁ = 0.28, CD = 0.28×193/1.35 ≈ 40 nm; the smallest resolvable half-pitch is λ/(4NA) = 193/5.4 ≈ 36 nm (k₁ = 0.25). For EUV with λ = 13.5 nm, NA = 0.33 and k₁ = 0.4, CD ≈ 16 nm, and about 10 nm at NA 0.55. The paraxial depth of focus λ/NA² is 193/1.8225 ≈ 106 nm for immersion and 124 nm for EUV at NA 0.33. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用測試光罩印出一組不同間距的線條，以 CD-SEM 量測最小仍能解析的半週期，反推實際 k₁ 並與 0.25 下限比較；再做對焦曝光矩陣（FEM）畫出 Bossung 曲線，讀出 CD 維持在 ±10% 內的可用景深，與 λ/NA² 估計值核對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Print a set of line pitches from a test reticle, measure the smallest half-pitch still resolved with a CD-SEM, back out the actual k₁ and compare it with the 0.25 floor; then run a focus-exposure matrix, plot Bossung curves and read the usable depth of focus over which CD stays within ±10%, checking it against the λ/NA² estimate.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: With λ = 193 nm, NA = 1.35 and k₁ = 0.28, CD = 0.28×193/1.35 ≈ 40 nm; the smallest resolvable half-pitch is λ/(4NA) = 193/5.4 ≈ 36 nm (k₁ = 0.25). For EUV with λ = 13.5 nm, NA = 0.33 and k₁ = 0.4, CD ≈ 16 nm, and about 10 nm at NA 0.55. The paraxial depth of focus λ/NA² is 193/1.8225 ≈ 106 nm for immersion and 124 nm for EUV at NA 0.33.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「Rayleigh 解析度與景深的系統邊界」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rayleigh resolution and depth-of-focus system boundaries", which statement holds?
options: 浸潤只是讓鏡頭更靠近晶圓，與 NA 無關。
鏡片吸收不到 1%，熱效應可以忽略。
optionsEn: Immersion merely brings the lens closer to the wafer and does not affect NA.
Elements absorb under 1%, so thermal effects are negligible.
With λ = 193 nm, NA = 1.35 and k₁ = 0.28, CD = 0.28×193/1.35 ≈ 40 nm; the smallest resolvable half-pitch is λ/(4NA) = 193/5.4 ≈ 36 nm (k₁ = 0.25).
quiz.explanationEn: With λ = 193 nm, NA = 1.35 and k₁ = 0.28, CD = 0.28×193/1.35 ≈ 40 nm; the smallest resolvable half-pitch is λ/(4NA) = 193/5.4 ≈ 36 nm (k₁ = 0.25). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: Rayleigh 解析度與景深的系統邊界：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rayleigh resolution and depth-of-focus system boundaries: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「投影鏡頭數值孔徑與像方空間」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Projection-lens NA and image space” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用測試光罩印出一組不同間距的線條，以 CD-SEM 量測最小仍能解析的半週期，反推實際 k₁ 並與 0.25 下限比較；再做對焦曝光矩陣（FEM）畫出 Bossung 曲線，讀出 CD 維持在 ±10% 內的可用景深，與 λ/NA² 估計值核對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Print a set of line pitches from a test reticle, measure the smallest half-pitch still resolved with a CD-SEM, back out the actual k₁ and compare it with the 0.25 floor; then run a focus-exposure matrix, plot Bossung curves and read the usable depth of focus over which CD stays within ±10%, checking it against the λ/NA² estimate. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若只按 CD 公式選 NA 而忽略景深縮小，晶圓高低差與對焦雜訊會吃掉整個製程窗口，結果是場邊緣線條隨機斷線或橋接，而鏡頭本身的像差數據卻完全合格。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Choosing NA from the CD formula alone while ignoring the shrinking depth of focus lets wafer topography and focus noise consume the whole process window, so lines at the field edge randomly break or bridge even though the lens aberration data pass every specification.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用測試光罩印出一組不同間距的線條，以 CD-SEM 量測最小仍能解析的半週期，反推實際 k₁ 並與 0.25 下限比較；再做對焦曝光矩陣（FEM）畫出 Bossung 曲線，讀出 CD 維持在 ±10% 內的可用景深，與 λ/NA² 估計值核對。
knowledge.textEn: Print a set of line pitches from a test reticle, measure the smallest half-pitch still resolved with a CD-SEM, back out the actual k₁ and compare it with the 0.25 floor; then run a focus-exposure matrix, plot Bossung curves and read the usable depth of focus over which CD stays within ±10%, checking it against the λ/NA² estimate.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「Rayleigh 解析度與景深的系統邊界」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rayleigh resolution and depth-of-focus system boundaries"?
options: 用測試光罩印出一組不同間距的線條，以 CD-SEM 量測最小仍能解析的半週期，反推實際 k₁ 並與 0.25 下限比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
操縱器越多，任何像差都能被完全修正。
optionsEn: Print a set of line pitches from a test reticle, measure the smallest half-pitch still resolved with a CD-SEM, back out the actual k₁ and compare it with the 0.25 floor.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
With enough manipulators every aberration can be corrected completely.
quiz.explanation: 用測試光罩印出一組不同間距的線條，以 CD-SEM 量測最小仍能解析的半週期，反推實際 k₁ 並與 0.25 下限比較；再做對焦曝光矩陣（FEM）畫出 Bossung 曲線，讀出 CD 維持在 ±10% 內的可用景深，與 λ/NA² 估計值核對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Print a set of line pitches from a test reticle, measure the smallest half-pitch still resolved with a CD-SEM, back out the actual k₁ and compare it with the 0.25 floor; then run a focus-exposure matrix, plot Bossung curves and read the usable depth of focus over which CD stays within ±10%, checking it against the λ/NA² estimate. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: Rayleigh 解析度與景深的系統邊界：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rayleigh resolution and depth-of-focus system boundaries: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「投影鏡頭數值孔徑與像方空間」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。

steps.title: 照明設定、部分同調與遠心：原理與系統邊界

steps.instruction: 照明系統把雷射光整形成光瞳上的特定分佈，用 σ 表示照明 NA 與投影 NA 的比值；離軸照明（環形、雙極）讓零階與一階繞射光對稱落入光瞳，能把可解析間距推到 λ/(2NA)。投影鏡頭在像方必須遠心：主光線垂直於晶圓，否則離焦會轉成放大率變化與套刻位移。光罩側也接近遠心，以降低光罩高度變化造成的位移。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「照明光瞳與部分同調」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

The projection lens must be telecentric on the image side, with chief rays normal to the wafer, otherwise defocus turns into magnification change and overlay shift. The reticle side is also nearly telecentric to suppress placement errors from reticle height variation. steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Under partially coherent illumination the minimum resolvable pitch is p_min = λ/(NA·(1+σ)): with σ = 0.5, p_min = 193/(1.35×1.5) ≈ 95 nm, and about 72 nm at σ = 1.

steps.objective: 說明「熔融石英與 CaF₂ 鏡片」如何決定ASML 微影投影光學工程的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。

steps.title: 深紫外鏡片材料、色散與面形預算：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「熔融石英與 CaF₂ 鏡片」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fused-silica and CaF₂ lens elements” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若系統波前 RMS 預算為 2.0 nm、由 30 片元件等額分擔，每片允許 2.0/√30 ≈ 0.37 nm 波前，對應熔融石英表面面形 0.37/0.56 ≈ 0.65 nm RMS；同樣預算若給 6 片反射鏡，每片為 2.0/√6 ≈ 0.82 nm 波前，即 0.41 nm 面形。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If the system wavefront RMS budget is 2.0 nm shared equally by 30 elements, each element may contribute 2.0/√30 ≈ 0.37 nm of wavefront, corresponding to a fused-silica surface figure of 0.37/0.56 ≈ 0.65 nm RMS; the same budget spread over 6 mirrors allows 2.0/√6 ≈ 0.82 nm of wavefront per mirror, i.e. 0.41 nm of figure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每片鏡片以干涉儀量測面形後換算成 193 nm 的波前貢獻，核對是否在分配值內；材料則用 193 nm 透過率與雷射誘發吸收量測，並以干涉儀量測整塊毛胚的折射率均勻性，確認體內折射率變化不會另外吃掉波前預算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure each element's figure interferometrically, convert it to wavefront contribution at 193 nm and check it against the allocation; qualify the material with 193 nm transmission and laser-induced absorption tests, and map the refractive-index homogeneity of each blank with an interferometer so that bulk index variation does not silently consume the wavefront budget.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 原位波前量測與 Zernike 分解：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「波前感測器與 Zernike 係數」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wavefront sensor and Zernike coefficients” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：傾斜項 Z₂ 係數 a₂ 造成像位移 Δx = a₂/NA：a₂ = 1 nm、NA = 1.35 時 Δx ≈ 0.74 nm。離焦項的近軸關係為 a₄ ≈ Δz·NA²/(4n)，故 a₄ = 1 nm 對應 Δz = 4n·a₄/NA² = 4×1.437/1.8225 ≈ 3.2 nm 的焦面偏移。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A tilt coefficient a₂ of Z₂ shifts the image by Δx = a₂/NA: with a₂ = 1 nm and NA = 1.35, Δx ≈ 0.74 nm. The paraxial defocus relation is a₄ ≈ Δz·NA²/(4n), so a₄ = 1 nm corresponds to a focus offset Δz = 4n·a₄/NA² = 4×1.437/1.8225 ≈ 3.2 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在多個場點重複量測波前，計算各 Zernike 項的重現性（通常要優於 0.1 nm），再用已知的靈敏度把 Z₇ 彗差預測的圖形位移與實際曝光的套刻量測比較，確認感測器座標、符號與縮放都與曝光結果一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Repeat the wavefront measurement at several field points, compute the repeatability of each Zernike term (typically required to be better than 0.1 nm), then compare the pattern shift predicted from the measured Z₇ coma through known sensitivities with the overlay actually printed, confirming that sensor coordinates, sign conventions and scaling agree with exposure results.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

The drift evolves on a minute scale during each lot, so it must be predicted by a thermal model and compensated in real time by lens manipulators, with the error budget covering both measurement uncertainty and model residuals. steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Expose continuously with a fixed illumination setting and measure the wavefront every few minutes, plot each Zernike term against accumulated dose, fit the thermal time constant and saturation level and compare with the thermal model; then switch illumination settings and record the cooling recovery curve to confirm the model predicts both directions.

steps.title: 鏡頭操縱器、前饋補償與校正收斂：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Lens manipulators, feedforward and correction convergence: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「鏡片操縱器與靈敏度矩陣」如何決定ASML 微影投影光學工程的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lens manipulators and sensitivity matrix” determines the key performance of “ASML lithography projection-optics engineering”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鏡頭內有若干片可由致動器沿軸向移動、傾斜或橫向平移的元件，另有可變形或可加熱的波前操縱元件；每個自由度對各 Zernike 項的靈敏度在出廠時以干涉量測建立成矩陣。校正時把量測到的像差向量以最小平方法反解成操縱器動作，同時要控制交叉耦合：修正球差的軸向移動也會改變離焦與放大率，必須由其他自由度同時抵消。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鏡片操縱器與靈敏度矩陣」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Several elements inside the lens can be moved axially, tilted or translated by actuators, and deformable or heated wavefront manipulators add further degrees of freedom; the sensitivity of each degree of freedom to every Zernike term is established interferometrically at the factory as a matrix. During correction the measured aberration vector is inverted by least squares into manipulator moves while cross-coupling is managed, because an axial move that corrects spherical aberration also changes focus and magnification and must be cancelled simultaneously by other degrees of freedom. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Lens manipulators and sensitivity matrix”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：設某元件軸向移動對 Z₉ 球差的靈敏度為 0.10 nm/µm，對 Z₄ 離焦的交叉靈敏度為 0.30 nm/µm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Suppose an element's axial move has a sensitivity of 0.10 nm/µm to Z₉ spherical aberration and a cross-sensitivity of 0.30 nm/µm to Z₄ defocus.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「操縱器越多，任何像差都能被完全修正。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With enough manipulators every aberration can be corrected completely." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「鏡片操縱器與靈敏度矩陣」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Lens manipulators and sensitivity matrix”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 鏡頭操縱器、前饋補償與校正收斂：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lens manipulators, feedforward and correction convergence: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鏡片操縱器與靈敏度矩陣」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lens manipulators and sensitivity matrix” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：設某元件軸向移動對 Z₉ 球差的靈敏度為 0.10 nm/µm，對 Z₄ 離焦的交叉靈敏度為 0.30 nm/µm。要修正 1.5 nm 的 Z₉ 需移動 15 µm，同時引入 4.5 nm 的 Z₄，必須由對焦系統抵消；致動器 20 nm 的解析度留下 0.002 nm 的 Z₉ 殘差，表示收斂極限由靈敏度矩陣的誤差而非致動器解析度決定。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Suppose an element's axial move has a sensitivity of 0.10 nm/µm to Z₉ spherical aberration and a cross-sensitivity of 0.30 nm/µm to Z₄ defocus. Correcting 1.5 nm of Z₉ requires a 15 µm move that also introduces 4.5 nm of Z₄, which the focus system must cancel; the actuator's 20 nm resolution leaves a Z₉ residual of only 0.002 nm, showing that the convergence limit is set by errors in the sensitivity matrix rather than by actuator resolution. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對每個操縱器施加已知步進並量測波前，重新擬合靈敏度矩陣並與出廠值比較，差異超過幾個百分比就更新；然後做閉環校正試驗，記錄每次疊代後的殘差 RMS，確認在兩到三次內收斂到預算以下且不出現振盪。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Apply known steps to each manipulator while measuring the wavefront, refit the sensitivity matrix and compare it with the factory values, updating it when differences exceed a few percent; then run a closed-loop correction trial, log the residual RMS after each iteration and confirm convergence below budget within two or three iterations without oscillation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

Correcting 1.5 nm of Z₉ requires a 15 µm move that also introduces 4.5 nm of Z₄, which the focus system must cancel; the actuator's 20 nm resolution leaves a Z₉ residual of only 0.002 nm, showing that the convergence limit is set by errors in the sensitivity matrix rather than by actuator resolution.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「鏡頭操縱器、前饋補償與校正收斂」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lens manipulators, feedforward and correction convergence", which statement holds?

steps.title: 鏡頭操縱器、前饋補償與校正收斂：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lens manipulators, feedforward and correction convergence: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「鏡片操縱器與靈敏度矩陣」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Lens manipulators and sensitivity matrix” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 對每個操縱器施加已知步進並量測波前，重新擬合靈敏度矩陣並與出廠值比較，差異超過幾個百分比就更新；然後做閉環校正試驗，記錄每次疊代後的殘差 RMS，確認在兩到三次內收斂到預算以下且不出現振盪。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Apply known steps to each manipulator while measuring the wavefront, refit the sensitivity matrix and compare it with the factory values, updating it when differences exceed a few percent; then run a closed-loop correction trial, log the residual RMS after each iteration and confirm convergence below budget within two or three iterations without oscillation. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：靈敏度矩陣若因鏡片老化而漂移，最小平方解會把能量推到條件數差的方向，操縱器大幅移動卻只換來微小改善，最後觸及行程極限而無法再校正。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the sensitivity matrix drifts with lens ageing, the least-squares solution pushes effort into poorly conditioned directions, so manipulators move a long way for little improvement and finally hit their travel limits, leaving the lens uncorrectable.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對每個操縱器施加已知步進並量測波前，重新擬合靈敏度矩陣並與出廠值比較，差異超過幾個百分比就更新；然後做閉環校正試驗，記錄每次疊代後的殘差 RMS，確認在兩到三次內收斂到預算以下且不出現振盪。
knowledge.textEn: Apply known steps to each manipulator while measuring the wavefront, refit the sensitivity matrix and compare it with the factory values, updating it when differences exceed a few percent; then run a closed-loop correction trial, log the residual RMS after each iteration and confirm convergence below budget within two or three iterations without oscillation.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鏡頭操縱器、前饋補償與校正收斂」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 鏡頭操縱器、前饋補償與校正收斂：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鏡片操縱器與靈敏度矩陣」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：校正時把量測到的像差向量以最小平方法反解成操縱器動作，同時要控制交叉耦合：修正球差的軸向移動也會改變離焦與放大率，必須由其他自由度同時抵消。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: During correction the measured aberration vector is inverted by least squares into manipulator moves while cross-coupling is managed, because an axial move that corrects spherical aberration also changes focus and magnification and must be cancelled simultaneously by other degrees of freedom.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「操縱器越多，任何像差都能被完全修正。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

steps.title: 系統成像驗證、套刻預算與工程交接：量測與驗證

steps.instruction: 以同一片晶圓做兩次曝光並量測套刻，分離出機台重複性與系統性畸變；對照 CD-SEM 的場內 CD 圖與波前推算的 CD 圖，核對殘差是否在量測不確定度內；最後確認交接文件的每個參數都有對應的量測日期與方法。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Expose the same wafer twice and measure overlay to separate machine repeatability from systematic distortion; compare the CD-SEM field map with the CD map predicted from the measured wavefront and confirm the residual lies within metrology uncertainty; finally check that every parameter in the handoff record carries a measurement date and method. steps.observation: 注意干擾：驗收若只核對元件與鏡頭報告而不做整機成像，裝機時的鏡頭座應力或照明對準誤差會被忽略，直到量產晶圓出現場邊緣 CD 偏差才發現，重新校正要停機數日。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Acceptance that only checks element and lens reports without full-system imaging misses mount stress or illuminator misalignment introduced at installation, which surfaces as field-edge CD deviation on production wafers and costs days of downtime to recalibrate.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
